title: An included file inherits the constructor local scope and can consume a parameter without any read in the constructor body itself.

ground_truth.statement: An included file inherits the constructor local scope and can consume a parameter without any read in the constructor body itself.

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Runtime controls distinguish successful values from rejected or absent alternatives. This is a behavior comparison, not a recommendation that every precision limitation is product policy. The included fragment lives outside the src analysis targets because it is only meaningful in its including constructor scope. The runtime includes the real fragment, not a stub. Initial standalone fragment diagnostics were fixture target errors, not analyzer findings. All three pinned analyzers accept this reduced semantic contract; its independent runtime controls pass.
